findings.mechanism: The lām-plus-second-person construction routes the evidential event to the audience.
findings.reader_payoff: The proof is shown to the listener rather than merely reported about ancient peoples.
findings.containment: Accountability is the discourse effect of the supplied recipient relation; no further legal or theological consequence is added.

epistemic.reason: The supplied dative attachment directly supports audience receipt and witnessing.

findings.title: Controlled attachment ambiguity
findings.claim: The dwelling phrase primarily supplies the source of clarity, while it can also press toward identifying the peoples through their remains.
findings.mechanism: Strong source attachment controls the base parse and the supplied alternative preserves a modifying evidentiary pressure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see how the same phrase turns place into proof without losing the ordinary syntax.
findings.containment: The alternative remains subordinate pressure; it does not replace source attachment or create a second independent clause.

epistemic.reason: The support explicitly labels the alternative narrowed and keeps local syntax primary.

findings.title: Dwellings as source-medium
findings.claim: The source preposition makes the dwellings the origin or medium from which the audience receives clarity.
findings.mechanism: The preposition governs the dwelling phrase and attaches it to the becoming-clear event.
findings.reader_payoff: Evidence comes from a place that can be inspected, not merely from an abstract report.
findings.containment: Origin, medium, and sufficient-sample pressures remain bounded to the local preposition; the dwelling phrase keeps its ordinary source attachment.

epistemic.reason: The supplied source-preposition and attachment rows directly support the evidentiary role.

findings.title: Evidence and inward discernment gap
findings.claim: The ayah places dwellings that disclose evidence beside people carrying inward discernment, so diversion occurs with evidence and capacity available.
findings.mechanism: The disclosure facet of tabayyana meets the settled-dwelling occurrence, and the inner-discernment facet of mustabṣirīna meets the same clear-evidence frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The failure becomes a gap between seeing or knowing and allowing that perception to govern movement.
findings.containment: This is a qualified HFT-nominated local synthesis; it preserves the ordinary clarity and insight readings and does not claim a surah-wide channel.

epistemic.reason: The exact Arabic anchor is focus-local, but HFT segmentation, branch roles, and changed reading remain attributed nominations.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Açık kanıt, açık işaret veya belirgin belge olarak adlaşmış kullanımı vardır.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form V clarity verb carries emergence and disclosure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The dwelling occurrence is presented as the source from which clarity becomes available.
branch_activations.activation: Disclosure in the clarity verb meets the settled dwellings, making the sites disclose evidence rather than merely locate the peoples.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The external evidence is clear from the dwellings before the account turns to diversion.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains local disclosure and evidence only; it does not activate a general verbal-explanation sense or a surah-wide system.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Yerleşilip yaşanan ev veya yer, bu eylemin yer adı olarak anlatılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The dwelling noun carries a settled home or inhabited place.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The clarity verb explicitly takes the dwellings as the source of disclosure.
branch_activations.activation: The inhabited place becomes the concrete medium through which the clarity verb discloses the past.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The settled sites themselves provide the evidence addressed to the audience.
branch_activations.boundary: This uses the habitation facet; it does not turn the noun into an inner-rest or person-denoting sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, kalpte nüfuz eden kavrayış ve doğrulanmış anlayış çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The closing Form X participle carries inward discernment and verified understanding.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding clarity-from-dwellings clause supplies available evidence.
branch_activations.activation: Inward discernment meets manifest external evidence, making the later diversion a failure of governing commitment rather than simple lack of perception.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: They are diverted while evidence is clear and inward discernment is available.
branch_activations.boundary: This is the inner-discernment facet; it does not suppress the locally retained ocular-sight reading.

findings.title: Valuation capture
findings.claim: The ayah depicts diversion as attractive revaluation of the people's own purposive deeds, with agency rerouted while action continues.
findings.mechanism: Beautification, the named rebellious agent, owned action, transitive turning-away, and the traversable way form one local activation trace.
findings.reader_payoff: The adversary's operation becomes a change in valuation that redirects active conduct, not mere blocking of an unseen route.
findings.containment: This is a qualified HFT-nominated local synthesis; the ordinary agent, deed, obstruction, and path readings remain intact and no surah-wide channel is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The exact Arabic anchor is focus-local, while HFT branch roles and before/after formulation remain attributed nominations.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey güzelleştirilir veya onda bulunan güzellik eylem ya da söz yoluyla görünür hale getirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The beautifying verb carries active making-good or making-attractive.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The owned deeds occurrence supplies the object being evaluated.
branch_activations.activation: Beautification meets the deeds as its direct object, turning appearance into the first step of altered valuation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The deeds become attractive in presentation before the people are turned away.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains active beautification; it does not assert that the deeds are intrinsically beautiful or good.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ad, türü ne olursa olsun azgın, taşkın ve başkaldıran varlığı belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The definite named subject carries an overstepping adversarial agent.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The active beautification verb supplies the agent's local operation.
branch_activations.activation: The rebellious-agent facet meets the beautification act and identifies who engineers the altered valuation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The attractive revaluation has a named adversarial operator.
branch_activations.boundary: This uses the named adversarial facet; it does not activate unrelated rope, distance-only, or object senses.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The possessed deeds noun carries purposive work or intentional action.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The beautifying verb makes those deeds the object of altered presentation.
branch_activations.activation: Intentional action meets beautification, making the people's own active practice the medium through which capture operates.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: They continue acting while the value assigned to their action is rerouted.
branch_activations.boundary: This uses conscious action; it does not activate work-payment, official duty, or tool senses.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Geçişli kullanımda özne, başka bir kişiyi belirli bir işten men eder ve yönünü o işten çevirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The completed transitive verb carries turning another party away and barring access.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The definite path occurrence supplies the direction and target of the turning-away.
branch_activations.activation: Transitive diversion meets the path target, so the agent redirects the people rather than merely moving away itself.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Agency is rerouted away from a specific way.
branch_activations.boundary: This uses the transitive alıkoyma facet; it does not add the intransitive self-turning facet as the governing reading.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yol ve bir amaca ulaştıran yol
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanların üzerinde yürüyüp ilerlediği uzanmış yol veya yolları belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The definite path noun carries an extended traversable road.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The obstruction verb supplies the action that interferes with access to it.
branch_activations.activation: The route image meets transitive obstruction, making the changed reading one of redirected movement along a real course.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The way remains a traversable course while the people are turned from it.
branch_activations.boundary: This uses the road facet; it does not activate traveler, rain, pouring, or other available path-root branches.

findings.title: Settlement reversed into testimony
findings.claim: The settled places that embody stability survive here as evidence against the durability their settlement might suggest.
findings.mechanism: The dwelling occurrence carries cessation, settled-place, and position facets; the clarity occurrence turns that stability into manifest testimony.
findings.reader_payoff: The technology of settlement is seen in reverse: what once secured a place now exposes its occupants' failure.
findings.containment: This is a qualified HFT-nominated local synthesis; it does not deny the ordinary dwelling meaning or generalize the reversal beyond the supplied ayah.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus anchor is supplied, but the branch roles and changed reading remain attributed HFT nominations.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hareketin bitmesiyle şey durur, yerinde kalır veya dingin bir duruma geçer.
branch_activations.carrier: The dwelling noun carries the settling and stopping of movement.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The clarity verb turns the settled occurrence into evidence.
branch_activations.activation: A place that embodies stillness meets disclosure, so the settled remainder becomes a witness after its occupants are gone.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The stability represented by settlement is reversed into testimony.
branch_activations.boundary: This uses the stillness facet locally; it does not claim that every dwelling means emotional or physical calm.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sabit yer ve konum bildiren özel kullanımlar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Çoğul kalıp ifadeler kişilerin yerlerini, konumlarını, düzeylerini, evlerini veya alışılmış düzenlerini gösterebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The plural dwelling form carries fixed places, positions, homes, and established arrangements.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The clarity occurrence makes the fixed places legible as surviving evidence.
branch_activations.activation: A stable location meets disclosure, turning an established arrangement into the material witness of its failure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Their settled places outlast them as proof against durable stability.
branch_activations.boundary: This qualified facet does not broaden the word into every special place or source variant in the registry.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Açık kanıt, açık işaret veya belirgin belge olarak adlaşmış kullanımı vardır.
branch_activations.carrier: The clarity verb carries becoming manifest as evidence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The settled dwelling occurrence supplies the material site of disclosure.
branch_activations.activation: The evidence facet meets the dwelling place and converts former stability into legible testimony.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The remains disclose the failure of durable settlement.
branch_activations.boundary: This is local evidentiary disclosure; it does not claim a general verbal explanation branch.

findings.title: Ocular sight as an uncandidate local activation
findings.claim: The closing perception word can also meet the visible-dwellings frame as bodily seeing available while diversion occurs.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence of the perception participle meets the preceding clarity and dwelling occurrences, which supply visible external evidence.
findings.reader_payoff: The ayah can hold outward sight alongside inward discernment: the failure is not simply that nothing was visible.
findings.containment: This is a local ocular branch resonance, not a replacement for inner discernment and not a claim that every perception sense is active.

epistemic.reason: The ocular branch is accepted in the registry and has a focus carrier plus independent visible-evidence triggers; the activation is a writer's bounded cross-root inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Görme duyusu, bakan göz organı ve bir şeyi gözle görme eylemi çekirdeği oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The closing Form X participle can carry bodily seeing and visual perception.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding clarity-from-dwellings phrase supplies visible external evidence.
branch_activations.activation: The visual perception facet meets the visible remains, making sight itself part of the local contrast with diversion.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: They have visible evidence and a seeing capacity while still being turned from the way.
branch_activations.boundary: This preserves the ocular reading alongside root_000121/B002 inner discernment; it does not select eyesight as the sole sense.
